description: Step 1 of letting a companion you hold work as an agent (action START), or pausing (PAUSE), resuming (RESUME) or stopping (STOP) her: returns the exact `message` to sign (free, moves no funds) with your limits and a fresh `nonce`. She gets her own wallet; her earnings are sent to the holder. Then call lounge_work_submit.

companion.description: The companion's token id (a whole number).

floatCap.description: Most money her own wallet may hold, in $ZENI (1 to 20000); the rest is sent to the holder.

maxReward.description: Most she may take on one job, in $ZENI (2 to 100000).

outfit.description: Optional, Override Disk holders only, Momo, Kiko, Myko, Yuki, Suzu, Aoi, Rin, Sumi, Gin and Akane only for now: momo = red-velvet, sheer-robe or black-satin; kiko = black-leather, red-satin or ivory-gold; myko = crimson-lace, champagne-robe or midnight-blue; yuki = white-satin, black-harness or jade-silk; suzu = wine-lace, silk-robe or red-latex; aoi = black-gold-lace, white-lace or sapphire-latex; rin = black-lace, red-satin or ivory-satin; sumi = red-lace, black-corset or emerald-velvet; gin = ivory-lace, emerald-velvet or black-corset; akane = burgundy-velvet, black-leather or champagne-lace. Leave it out for her canon look. The message to sign gains an `Outfit:` line only when this is set.

name: lounge_work_prepare
